description: Build net units sold per SKU per store-local day, subtracting cancellations and refunds from the original sales. For Shopify use orders plus inventory exports; for WooCommerce use the orders export and current stock; for a spreadsheet group sales by SKU and local date. Include zero-sales days. Never infer missing history as zero, clamp negative values or invent facts; ask the merchant to reconcile refunds when the export cannot establish net sales. Ask the merchant for lead times, review periods, minimum orders and case packs. Stock is the stock on hand at as_of. Ask about incoming orders and committed stock: this preview assumes neither is present. History must end the day before as_of and cover max(365,257+largest lead_time_days+review_period_days) days, at most 468. Quantities and order values are final: quote them exactly as returned, without rounding or changing them. A null quantity means no safe quantity was returned. Use a stock count dated today or up to 8 days ago in the store's time zone. Send a fresh stock count if it is older. For an earlier count within that window, the preview names the stock count date and adds expected sales since then, up to the counted stock for each SKU. Send every selected SKU in a compact daily units array starting at start_date, up to 20 SKUs. Each array position is the next day. All amounts are in the store currency. No account or files are saved.

as_of.description: Stock count date (YYYY-MM-DD). The daily sales end the day before it. Use a stock count dated today or up to 8 days ago in the store's time zone. Send a fresh stock count if it is older. For an earlier count within that window, the preview names the stock count date and adds expected sales since then, up to the counted stock for each SKU.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the store currency, for example USD. Unit costs and order values use it.

platform.description: Where the store runs: shopify, woocommerce or other.

skus.description: One entry per SKU to preview, up to 20.

case_pack.description: Units per case. Orders are rounded up to whole cases; 1 if sold singly.

lead_time_days.description: Days from placing an order with the supplier to receiving it.

minimum_order.description: Supplier minimum order in units; 1 if there is none.

review_period_days.description: Days between reorders of this SKU, for example 7 for weekly.

sku.description: The SKU code as the store shows it.

start_date.description: Store-local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the first value in units.

stock_on_hand.description: Units on hand at as_of, not counting incoming purchase orders.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit in the store currency. Leave it out if unknown; order values then exclude this SKU.

units.description: Net units sold per store-local day, from start_date through the day before as_of, after cancellations and refunds. Use 0 for days without sales.

timezone.description: IANA store time zone, for example America/New_York

title: Preview a reorder plan
